chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Marge gave up the piano for home
summary: Marge stopped playing because Zutty was jealous and she did not want to ride in cars of band members; she stayed home and cared for him, and that, she says, is why they stayed together.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well Marge, were you more of a soloist or did you sort of really remain like a band pianist? And what happened to you?

I didn't want any parts because I told, I knew Zutt and I would not stay together. Because I couldn't play with him in the 50 big band. And I knew if I was playing all over jobs we would have separated. That's all. I wanted to be just a housewife. And at that time, I mean, then we sent for his mother. You know, his mother was living with us too. And she wasn't well. But I did not want I didn't want to play piano. And I was so glad to get out of it.

Because as I said to Zutt, Zutt was a jealous man and I knew we just couldn't go through that fighting about, I know he'd say I was going with one of the musicians. Oh what a man, he was so, you never saw anybody as jealous as he was.
I was thinking about how she
she would have to sit on some cat's lap.

You know, with all the band travelling in one car and all. So I said, rather than that I'll give it up. That's all, I don't want to have any parts of it I'd rather stay home. He was making enough money for us to, well then when he got out of work naturally I'd want to work at just any kind of job, it didn't make any difference as long as there was some money coming in.
Because I remember that's why we stayed together. I guess I dare say if I'd kept playing the piano ......
That's why we stayed together because we never did have too much money.
No, and Zutty never made that money to support two women like Louis. (LAUGHTER). He could only support one. And I came remember I just stayed home and took care of him.
So you always had a home?
That's right. That's right. And I guess that's why we....... Because if I'd kept on with my career I know we wouldn't have been together.
